text: Let me show you what I want to do with G2, alongside T3 Code.
In T3 Code, a thread is one job and the conversation around it.
Most threads can keep moving, or finish, without me.
I only get a nudge when there’s a choice to make.
On a walk, I stop and open the note in my glasses.
I’m not ready to decide, so I tap Later on the ring.
Waiting for the Shinkansen, I reopen the thread.
Newer phones are ready. Older phones need more testing.
Give newer phones the new search first, or wait for everyone?
Before I choose, I ask: will search still work on older phones?
Later, the answer comes back. Yes. They’ll keep today’s search.
Good. I choose Newer phones first, and confirm the reply.
That’s my decision. The agents can take it from here.
At a pause: no decisions waiting. The agents are testing.
The checks pass, and the change merges under rules already in place.
Only the work that needs you.
